description: Main entry point and app configuration for a Flutter-based secure session application utilizing provider for state management and implementing biometric authentication, token storage, and navigation between login, lock, and home screens.

classes.name: SecureSessionApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up MaterialApp with theme and initial route, encapsulating the entire app.

classes.name: RootRouter
classes.description: Determines the initial screen based on authentication state, managing navigation between Splash, Login, Lock, and Home screens.

classes.name: _SplashScreen
classes.description: Temporary loading screen shown while authentication state initializes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes Flutter binding and runs the app within a MultiProvider setup for dependency injection.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for SecureSessionApp and RootRouter, handling app theming and routing logic.
